lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਪੇਖਤ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan rav rahiaa jagadeesur pekhat sadaa hajoore ||
lines.translation: The Lord of the Universe is permeating and pervading my mind and body; I see Him Ever-present, here and now.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak rav rahio sabh a(n)tar sarab rahiaa bharapoore ||2||8||12||
lines.translation: O Nanak, He is permeating the inner being of all; He is all-pervading everywhere. ||2||8||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਜਨਿ ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਨ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kai bhajan kaun kaun na taare ||
lines.translation: Vibrating and meditating on the Lord, who has not been carried across?

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਗ ਤਨ ਮੀਨ ਤਨ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤਨ ਬਰਾਹ ਤਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: khag tan meen tan mrig tan baraah tan saadhoo sa(n)g udhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Those reborn into the body of a bird, the body of a fish, the body of a deer, and the body of a bull - in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they are saved. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵ ਕੁਲ ਦੈਤ ਕੁਲ ਜਖੵ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਨਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dev kul dait kul jakhy ki(n)nar nar saagar utare paare ||
lines.translation: The families of gods, the families of demons, titans, celestial singers and human beings are carried across the ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਭਜਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo jo bhajan karai saadhoo sa(n)g taa ke dookh bidaare ||1||
lines.translation: Whoever meditates and vibrates on the Lord in the Saadh Sangat - his pains are taken away. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਇਨ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam karodh mahaa bikhiaa ras in te bhae niraare ||
lines.translation: Sexual desire, anger and the pleasures of terrible corruption - he keeps away from these.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਜਪਹਿ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal japahi karunaa mai naanak sad balihaare ||2||9||13||
lines.translation: He meditates on the Lord, Merciful to the meek, the Embodiment of Compassion; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||9||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਜੁ ਮੈ ਬੈਸਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਟ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaj mai baisio har haat ||
lines.translation: Today, I am seated in the Lord's store.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਾਝੀ ਕਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਂਉ ਨ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਘਾਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam raas saajhee kar jan siu jaa(n)u na jam kai ghaat ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: With the wealth of the Lord, I have entered into partnership with the humble; I shall not have take the Highway of Death. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਖੁਲੑੇ ਕਪਾਟ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaar anugrahu paarabraham raakhe bhram ke khulhe kapaat ||
lines.translation: Showering me with His Kindness, the Supreme Lord God has saved me; the doors of doubt have been opened wide.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਸਾਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਧਿ ਖਾਟ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: besumaar saahu prabh paaiaa laahaa charan nidh khaat ||1||
lines.translation: I have found God, the Banker of Infinity; I have earned the profit of the wealth of His Feet. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਢੇ ਹੈ ਛਾਂਟਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saran gahee achut abinaasee kilabikh kaadhe hai chhaa(n)t ||
lines.translation: I have grasped the protection of the Sanctuary of the Unchanging, Unmoving, Imperishable Lord; He has picked up my sins and thrown them out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੇ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਮਾਟ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: kal kales mite daas naanak bahur na jonee maat ||2||10||14||
lines.translation: Slave Nanak's sorrow and suffering has ended. He shall never again be squeezed into the mold of reincarnation. ||2||10||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਹਿਰਾਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahu bidh maaiaa moh hiraano ||
lines.translation: In so many ways, attachment to Maya leads to ruin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋਊ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਤੁ ਚਿਰਾਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot madhe kooo biralaa sevak pooran bhagat chiraano ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Among millions, it is very rare to find a selfless servant who remains a perfect devotee for very long. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਡੋਲਿ ਡੋਲਿ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਤ ਬਿਰਾਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: it ut dol dol sram paaio tan dhan hot biraano ||
lines.translation: Roaming and wandering here and there, the mortal finds only trouble; his body and wealth become strangers to himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਗ ਦੁਰਾਇ ਕਰਤ ਠਗਿਆਈ ਹੋਤੌ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: log duraai karat thagiaaee hotau sa(n)g na jaano ||1||
lines.translation: Hiding from people, he practices deception; he does not know the One who is always with him. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਪੰਖੀ ਮੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਨੀਚ ਇਹ ਸੰਕਟ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: mrig pa(n)khee meen deen neech ih sa(n)kat phir aano ||
lines.translation: He wanders through troubled incarnations of low and wretched species as a deer, a bird and a fish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਹਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨੋ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak paahan prabh taarahu saadhasa(n)gat sukh maano ||2||11||15||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, O God, I am a stone - please carry me across, that I may enjoy peace in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||11||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਟ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dusat mue bikh khaaee ree maaee ||
lines.translation: The cruel and evil ones died after taking poison, O mother.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis ke jee tin hee rakh leene mere prabh kau kirapaa aaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: And the One, to whom all creatures belong, has saved us. God has granted His Grace. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਾਂ ਭਉ ਕੈਸਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tarajaamee sabh mahi varatai taa(n) bhau kaisaa bhaaee ||
lines.translation: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is contained within all; why should I be afraid, O Siblings of Destiny?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭਨੀ ਠਾਈਁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)g sahaaee chhod na jaaee prabh deesai sabhanee thaaee(n) ||1||
lines.translation: God, my Help and Support, is always with me. He shall never leave; I see Him everywhere. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: anaathaa naath deen dukh bha(n)jan aap leee laR laaee ||
lines.translation: He is the Master of the masterless, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor; He has attached me to the hem of His robe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: har kee ot jeevahi daas tere naanak prabh saranaaee ||2||12||16||
lines.translation: O Lord, Your slaves live by Your Support; Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of God. ||2||12||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: malaar mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere har ke charan raveejai ||
lines.translation: O my mind, dwell on the Feet of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਪੰਖ ਲਗਾਇ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: daras piaas mero man mohio har pa(n)kh lagaai mileejai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: My mind is enticed by thirst for the Blessed Vision of the Lord; I would take wings and fly out to meet Him. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: khojat khojat maarag paaio saadhoo sev kareejai ||
lines.translation: Searching and seeking, I have found the Path, and now I serve the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dhaar anugrahu suaamee mere naam mahaa ras peejai ||1||
lines.translation: O my Lord and Master, please be kind to me, that I may drink in Your most sublime essence. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਏ ਜਲਤਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: traahi traahi kar saranee aae jalatau kirapaa keejai ||
lines.translation: Begging and pleading, I have come to Your Sanctuary; I am on fire - please shower me with Your Mercy!

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: kar gahi lehu daas apune kau naanak apuno keejai ||2||13||17||
lines.translation: Please give me Your Hand - I am Your slave, O Lord. Please make Nanak Your Own. ||2||13||17||
